issues.where: crop 5, the frosted soil clods across the left foreground (also set-C-07 lower left)
issues.what: the clods are smooth rounded blobs with a glossy, plasticine sheen and flat white patches laid on their tops; they read as modelled clay with a frost decal, not crumbly soil with frost crystals growing on it
issues.fix: break the clods into rough crumbs and aggregates, kill the specular sheen, and grow frost as fine crystalline rime that follows the surface relief and is denser on exposed edges

issues.where: crops 1-3, the edges of every leaf
issues.what: the frost on the leaf margins is a row of bright white fluffy tufts stuck out at regular spacing, like glued cotton; it glows evenly against the sky and looks like an added effect rather than hoar frost; the leaf blades themselves are a flat grey-green with almost no vein relief or translucency
issues.fix: replace the tufts with small, irregular needle crystals of varying length, keep them on the upper surface and the hairs as well as the margin, and give the blades visible veins and some backlit translucency where the frost is thin

issues.what: the leaves share nearly the same outline, serration and frosting, and several sit as flat stiff cards on their petioles, so the plant reads as one leaf instanced and scaled
issues.fix: vary outline, size, curl and droop per leaf, and add some twist and cupping so none lies flat

issues.where: crop 1, the hook at the soil
issues.what: the hook is a smooth, single flat green tube with an even waxy sheen and no hairs; the soil crumbs on it look like flat cut-out stickers; directly right of it is a large smooth dark slab with no crumb detail that reads as a hole in the soil model
issues.fix: add surface hairs, subtle colour variation and a pale-to-green gradient on the hook; make the clinging crumbs three-dimensional with contact shadows; fill the dark slab with crumb geometry

issues.where: crop 1 and crop 7, the seed leaves
issues.what: the seed leaves are one even green with a waxy sheen and painted-looking veins, and the dew drops are near-identical bright beads spaced evenly along the margin
issues.fix: add tonal variation, thickness and a slightly matte, cellular surface; vary the dew in size, spacing and shape, with some merged and some missing

issues.where: crop 2, the foot of the stem
issues.what: the stem meets the soil as a straight-sided cylinder with a hard horizontal change in tone near its base and little contact shadow; the soil around it has smooth, shiny planar patches unlike the crumbs elsewhere
issues.fix: add a soft occlusion shadow and a few crumbs pushed up against the stem, remove the tonal step, and replace the shiny patches with crumb detail

issues.where: crops 3-4, the grass blades (also set-C-04 crops 4 and 7)
issues.what: the grass blades are flat single-green ribbons with no midrib, no edge thickness and no translucency, and the dew drops on them are uniform spheres with the same highlight
issues.fix: give the blades a midrib, edge thickness, colour variation from base to tip and backlit translucency; vary dew size and highlight

issues.where: crop 1 and crop 2, soil particles on the stem
issues.what: the dark crumbs clinging to the stem are flat, similar-sized blobs with no shadow on the stem, so they look pasted on
issues.fix: vary their size and shape and give each a contact shadow

issues.where: crops 5-8, the sky, glow and out-of-focus soil
issues.what: the grain in the dark, out-of-focus areas is coloured and slightly blotchy when zoomed
issues.fix: denoise the defocused regions a little more, or match grain across the frame
